title: Public documentation summary: OpenAI structured output (reviewed 2026-10-23)
content: The OpenAI Responses API supports JSON schema constraints for generated text through text.format. The store field can disable response storage. Schema-constrained output still needs handling for refusals and incomplete responses.

title: Public documentation summary: Anthropic structured output (reviewed 2026-10-23)
content: The Anthropic Messages API accepts a JSON schema through output_config.format. Returned JSON text appears in content blocks. A refusal or max_tokens stop reason needs separate handling and must not be treated as a successful schema-valid answer.

title: Public documentation summary: xAI structured output (reviewed 2026-10-23)
content: The xAI Responses API supports a JSON schema in text.format. Generated text is returned inside message items in the output array. Model support and account availability must be checked before selecting an exact model identifier.
